instruction: Every step of rich's console protocol passes the `Console` and the `ConsoleOptions` side by side, although options are always derived from one console. Make the options carry it: add a required field `console: "Console"` to the `ConsoleOptions` dataclass (rich/console.py; declare it right after `max_height`, with `field(repr=False, compare=False)` so repr/equality do not change) and set it in `Console.options`; options derived with `copy()`/`update*()` keep it. Then drop the `console` parameter everywhere the pair is passed: `__rich_console__(self, console, options)` becomes `__rich_console__(self, options)`, `__rich_measure__(self, console, options)` becomes `__rich_measure__(self, options)`, `Measurement.get(console, options, renderable)` becomes `Measurement.get(options, renderable)`, and `measure_renderables(console, options, renderables)` becomes `measure_renderables(options, renderables)`. Update every implementation (every renderable in the `rich` package, the protocol definitions, and renderables defined in tests) -- an implementation that uses the console now reads it from `options.console` -- and every call, including calls made through a local alias of `Measurement.get` or through a bound `__rich_measure__` looked up with `getattr`, and every `ConsoleOptions(...)` constructed directly (in tests, pass the console the test used, or `Console()`). `Console.render` and `Console.measure` must still render/measure with the console they were called on, even when handed options that were made by another console. Do not keep a console parameter, an optional console argument, or a compatibility shim. Behavior must not change.
gold_tool: build_deep.py recipe: implementations found in the ast (console parameter removed, `console = options.console` inserted after the docstring only where the body uses it); calls (direct, Measurement.get aliases, getattr-bound __rich_measure__) lose their first argument via the masked-text call finder; ConsoleOptions constructions get console=; Console.render/measure rebind foreign options; rich's suite in docker confirms
change: protocol change: options object gains a required field; four APIs (__rich_console__, __rich_measure__, Measurement.get, measure_renderables) drop a parameter; implementations rebind it only where used; aliased/getattr call sites
notes: Shapes: 3-parameter protocol defs, protocol/Measurement.get/measure_renderables calls with the old argument count (incl. the local aliases get_measurement/get_render_width/measure and get_console_width), and ConsoleOptions(...) constructions without console=.

problem_statement: Every step of rich's console protocol passes the `Console` and the `ConsoleOptions` side by side, although options are always derived from one console. Make the options carry it: add a required field `console: "Console"` to the `ConsoleOptions` dataclass (rich/console.py; declare it right after `max_height`, with `field(repr=False, compare=False)` so repr/equality do not change) and set it in `Console.options`; options derived with `copy()`/`update*()` keep it. Then drop the `console` parameter everywhere the pair is passed: `__rich_console__(self, console, options)` becomes `__rich_console__(self, options)`, `__rich_measure__(self, console, options)` becomes `__rich_measure__(self, options)`, `Measurement.get(console, options, renderable)` becomes `Measurement.get(options, renderable)`, and `measure_renderables(console, options, renderables)` becomes `measure_renderables(options, renderables)`. Update every implementation (every renderable in the `rich` package, the protocol definitions, and renderables defined in tests) -- an implementation that uses the console now reads it from `options.console` -- and every call, including calls made through a local alias of `Measurement.get` or through a bound `__rich_measure__` looked up with `getattr`, and every `ConsoleOptions(...)` constructed directly (in tests, pass the console the test used, or `Console()`). `Console.render` and `Console.measure` must still render/measure with the console they were called on, even when handed options that were made by another console. Do not keep a console parameter, an optional console argument, or a compatibility shim. Behavior must not change.
